The important thing that happened in the early 1980s was VHS, that was now affordable for everyone. That changed the market from TV and toy centric towards a boom of OVAs. Suddenly anime could make money by selling the show directly on VHS. That's where Gundams second wind came from. Now the fans could buy the show on VHS - and they did. Prior to 1981 anime wasn't sold on VHS. The studios were slow moving back then, too. (VHS came out in 1976 or something like that.)
